```{r}
#| include: false
# Shared setup, included at the top of every chapter.
# Point R at the Python used for the {python} chunks. Set HDS_PYTHON_ENV in
# .Renviron if your conda environment is not called "hds-python".
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#>", fig.align = "center", dpi = 150)
if (requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly = TRUE) &&
    Sys.getenv("RETICULATE_PYTHON") == "") {
  try(reticulate::use_condaenv(Sys.getenv("HDS_PYTHON_ENV", "hds-python"),
                               required = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
}
```
